title: build save never overwrites a file of jitso/builds/ and never takes the id of a saved build, with --yes or without; nothing is written or deleted
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, "Only launches are blocked, and launches into other repositories": build save writes with no owner gate; --yes is accepted and changes nothing
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-15, drafts; docs/decisions.md "The v0.1.0 cut"). A draft whose id is the id of a saved build of the project is `JITSO REJECTED: jitso/builds/<id>.yaml already exists: save never overwrites a build`; so is a draft whose target file exists under another id. A draft whose id a saved build already has under another file name (here scan-copy.yaml) is `JITSO REJECTED: build "<id>" already exists (<layer> <path>): a draft needs an id no build has`. The answer is the same with `--yes` and without. The saved file and the draft are left as they were.
